chaostuin — calculation details

Below, step by step and using your own chosen values, is how the mulch calculator arrives at its result. Feel free to adjust the sliders below to see how each intermediate result changes.

1From % organic matter to kg humus per m²

The sliders work in percent organic matter (%OM), but the calculation core works in kg humus per m². The conversion is based on the rule of thumb: 10 kg humus/m² corresponds to roughly 3% organic matter (at a soil depth of 25 cm) — that's a conversion factor of 10/3 ≈ 3.33 kg/m² per percent.

H0 (current) = —% × 3.33 = — kg/m²
Hgoal = —% × 3.33 = — kg/m²

2Build-up phase or maintenance phase?

First it's checked whether your goal is above your current level. If so: you're in the build-up phase, and the calculator works out how much mulch you need each year to reach your goal within the chosen number of years. If not (you've already reached your goal): you're in the maintenance phase, and the calculator only works out what's needed to hold your current level.

—

3Mulch needed during the build-up phase

The amount of humus in the soil changes each year according to: addition via mulch (humification factor h = 10%: 10 kg mulch yields 1 kg humus) minus breakdown (k = 2.5% of the humus present, per year). For a chosen period of N years, this gives the required yearly mulch dose m:

m = (k / h) × (Hgoal − H0 × e−k×N) / (1 − e−k×N)

Filled in with your values (N = — years):

e−0.025 × — = —
m = 0.25 × (— − — × —) / (1 − —)
m = 0.25 × — / —
m = — kg/m²/year

3Mulch needed during the maintenance phase

You've already reached your goal (or your current level is already at or above your goal). So no more net build-up is needed — only the yearly breakdown of 2.5% needs to be compensated to keep the level stable (equilibrium formula):

m = (k / h) × H0 = 0.25 × — = — kg/m²/year

4Converting to a mulch layer in cm

Loose garden mulch weighs roughly 200 kg per m³. An amount in kg/m²/year is therefore converted to layer thickness in centimeters by dividing by 2 (200 kg/m³ ÷ 100 cm/m = 2 kg per cm of layer thickness per m²).

— kg/m²/year ÷ 2 = — cm mulch layer per year

5Comparison with what you have available

Finally, the required amount is compared with what you indicated on the "What do I have available to mulch with?" slider.

available = — kg/m²/year (≈ — cm/year)
ratio = available / needed = — / — = —

At a ratio ≥ 100% there's enough (🟢); between 60% and 100% it's achievable with extra collection from outside the vegetable garden (🟡); below that there's too little (🔴). If the required amount is above 50 kg/m²/year (≈ 25 cm/year, the practical maximum for an applied mulch layer), 🔴 is shown regardless — that goal simply isn't physically realistic within the chosen timeframe.
